summary: iOS release delivery refuses to compile missing Nix toolchains: workspace preparation and the Rust toolchain must already be available locally or from configured binary caches.

compatibility.detail: Cargo and Xcode app compilation are unchanged. Nix realization now disables local, remote and external builders during delivery.

downtime.detail: No service restart required; a missing toolchain closure stops delivery before app compilation.

manual.detail: Publish the required toolchain closures and configure the delivery environment's binary cache substituters before retrying a cache miss.

recovery.detail: Populate the cache and retry delivery; revert the change to restore build-on-miss behavior.
